hypothesis.description:
For a MARKET-NEUTRAL CARRY in BTC -- long BTC-USD spot, short BitMEX XBTUSD at equal notional -- the mean forward carry return in the group 'CARRYFUNDING_t >= 0 (the premium is being paid)' is HIGHER than in 'CARRYFUNDING_t < 0 (the premium has inverted)'. Direction INCREASE pre-declared.

PROVENANCE AND CORRECTION: selected as rank 0 of 8 candidates in sealed Discovery scan DISCOVERY_SCAN|6d298f423a308ebca9ea8da0013b63a31668501bc98c77891d4524688baabd10, which read 2017-01-01 to 2019-01-01 and nothing else. This period is that space's declared holdout. Bonferroni over 8, and 8 folds so the corrected test is passable at all -- the previous attempt used five against a search of eight, where the smallest attainable p-value (0.03125) exceeded the bar (0.00625) and no outcome could have passed.

FUNDING AT 3 PAYMENTS A DAY, which is BitMEX's eight-hour settlement. The outcome is the funding received MINUS the change in basis: a cash flow plus a spread mark, not a price change.

NO LOOKAHEAD: the row at t is classified by funding at t-1 and the outcome reads t+1, two periods apart. The 1-day warmup precedes the period and feeds the indicator, never the measured outcome.

records.interpretation:
Regla de salida del carry BTC en BitMEX XBTUSD, evaluada sobre un HOLDOUT declarado antes del scan. Candidata: CARRY_FUNDING_THRESHOLD {'funding_variable': 'funding_rate', 'perpetual_variable': 'perp_close', 'threshold': '0', 'payments_per_period': 3}, rango 0 de 8 en el scan DISCOVERY_SCAN|6d298f423a308ebca9ea8da0013b63a31668501bc98c77891d4524688baabd10.

El test es PASABLE por construccion: 8 folds, p minimo alcanzable 0.00391, barra corregida 0.00625. El intento anterior sobre Hyperliquid uso cinco folds contra una busqueda de ocho y no podia pasar.

Resultado: metric=0.000338, grupos 589/331, ACCEPTED. Walk-forward 8/8 MET, consistencia 1.0, p binomial 0.00390625 contra alfa None -> VALIDATED.
limitations: Valida la REGLA DE SALIDA, no si la prima compensa el riesgo. Esa es una afirmacion de nivel, y level_claim ya devolvio NOT_VALIDATED para el carry mantenido de forma continua en 2019-2021 por romper el limite de drawdown.
Un venue, un instrumento, un horizonte.
El warmup de 1 dias precede al periodo y alimenta el indicador, nunca el outcome medido.
La candidata fue seleccionada como la mejor de 8 sobre la ventana de descubrimiento. La correccion por esa seleccion se aplica aqui; no la deshace.
BitMEX XBTUSD es un contrato INVERSO: el P&L en USD de un corto no es lineal en el precio, y el Outcome lo trata como si lo fuera. Es una aproximacion, no una identidad.
